mapper.select: SELECT name AS "name", location AS "source", value AS "hash", properties_json::text AS "propertiesJson" FROM analysis_resource WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND resource_type = 'RULE_SET' ORDER BY resource_id
mapper.sql: SELECT 'ENDPOINT'::text AS kind, e.endpoint_type::text AS category , concat_ws('|', e.endpoint_type, e.http_method, e.path, e.method_id, e.symbol_id, e.file_id) AS key , concat_ws(' ', e.endpoint_type, e.http_method, e.path, '→', COALESCE(ms.fqn || '#' || m.signature, s.fqn, f.path)) AS label FROM analysis_endpoint e LEFT JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = e.revision_id AND m.method_id = e.method_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol ms ON ms.revision_id = m.revision_id AND ms.symbol_id = m.owner_symbol_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = e.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = e.symbol_id LEFT JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = e.file_id WHERE e.revision_id = #{revisionId} UNION ALL SELECT 'LAYER', s.layer || '(' || s.layer_confidence || ')' , concat_ws('|', s.symbol_id, s.layer, s.layer_confidence) , s.fqn || ' = ' || s.layer || '(' || s.layer_confidence || ')' FROM analysis_symbol s WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.layer IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'PROXY', 'PROXY_RELATED', m.method_id, ms.fqn || '#' || m.signature FROM analysis_method m JOIN analysis_symbol ms ON ms.revision_id = m.revision_id AND ms.symbol_id = m.owner_symbol_id WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.proxy_related UNION ALL SELECT 'RELATION', r.relation_type || '(' || r.confidence || ')' , concat_ws('|', r.from_id, r.relation_type, r.to_id, r.to_external, r.confidence, r.file_id, r.line_start) , COALESCE(fm.label, r.from_id) || ' ─' || r.relation_type || '→ ' || COALESCE(tm.label, r.to_external, r.to_id) FROM analysis_relation r LEFT JOIN LATERAL () fm ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL () tm ON TRUE WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.relation_type IN ('INJECTS', 'RENDERS', 'REQUESTS', 'INCLUDES', 'EXECUTES_SQL', 'READS_TABLE', 'WRITES_TABLE')

SELECT CASE ${k} WHEN 'METHOD' THEN (SELECT s.fqn || '#' || m.signature FROM analysis_method m JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = m.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = m.owner_symbol_id WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.method_id = ${i}) WHEN 'TYPE' THEN (SELECT s.fqn FROM analysis_symbol s WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.symbol_id = ${i}) WHEN 'FILE' THEN (SELECT f.path FROM analysis_file f WHERE f.file_id = substr(${i}, 2)::bigint) WHEN 'SQL' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(mp.namespace || '.', '') || mp.statement_id FROM analysis_mapper mp WHERE mp.mapper_id = substr(${i}, 2)::bigint) END AS label WHERE ${i} IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: CREATE TEMP TABLE trial_before ON COMMIT DROP AS
CREATE TEMP TABLE trial_after ON COMMIT DROP AS
mapper.select: WITH added AS (SELECT kind, category, key FROM trial_after EXCEPT ALL SELECT kind, category, key FROM trial_before) , removed AS (SELECT kind, category, key FROM trial_before EXCEPT ALL SELECT kind, category, key FROM trial_after) , cats AS (SELECT kind, category FROM trial_before UNION SELECT kind, category FROM trial_after) SELECT c.kind AS "kind", c.category AS "category" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trial_before b WHERE b.kind = c.kind AND b.category = c.category) AS "before" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trial_after a WHERE a.kind = c.kind AND a.category = c.category) AS "after" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM added a WHERE a.kind = c.kind AND a.category = c.category) AS "added" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM removed r WHERE r.kind = c.kind AND r.category = c.category) AS "removed" FROM cats c ORDER BY c.kind, c.category

SELECT e->>'kind' AS "kind", e->>'function' AS "function", e->>'template' AS "template" , (e->>'argIndex')::int AS "argIndex", (e->>'calls')::int AS "calls" , best.k::int AS "literalAt", best.v::int AS "literalCalls" FROM analysis_resource r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.properties_json->'notLiteral') AS e CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT key AS k, value AS v FROM jsonb_each_text(e->'literalAt') ORDER BY value::int DESC, key::int LIMIT 1) best WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.resource_type = 'SEMANTIC_STATUS' AND r.name = 'SCREEN_RULES' ORDER BY best.v::int DESC, 2

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_symbol s WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.kind <> 'ANONYMOUS' AND s.properties_json->>'synthetic' IS NULL) AS "types" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_symbol s WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.kind <> 'ANONYMOUS' AND s.properties_json->>'synthetic' IS NULL AND s.layer IS NULL) AS "typesWithoutLayer" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_symbol s WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.layer_confidence = 'LOW') AS "typesWithLowLayer" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_endpoint e WHERE e.revision_id = #{revisionId}) AS "endpoints" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.relation_type = 'EXECUTES_SQL' AND r.resolution_status = 'RESOLVED') AS "sqlCalls" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.relation_type = 'EXECUTES_SQL' AND r.resolution_status = 'UNRESOLVED') AS "sqlCallsNotFound" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_mapper m WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.statement_type <> 'SQL_FRAGMENT' AND m.method_id IS NULL) AS "statementsWithoutCaller"
